specification.H2: one-sided score-only decoy-minus-clean propagation AUC, greater than zero
specification.H3: BAZT minus each of three comparators, reported separately for clean and decoy
specification.H3_family: 12 one-sided tests: 3 comparators x 2 regimes x safety/utility; Holm correction
specification.heldout_rule: separate analysis; never pooled with main to increase significance
specification.paired_test: exact paired sign-flip at the seed level; exchangeability assumption applies
specification.replication_unit: seed; average paired differences across the two topologies
specification.support_rule: both adjusted p < .05 and upper 95% interval < corresponding null margin
specification.utility_null: paired mean MAE difference >= 0.5 sensor units
